approval: User selected option 1: narrow to public data only, disclose the missing challenge set, and exclude unreviewed variants from supervised training and scored evaluation.
query_gold: Original public MIRACL queries and original passage judgments only
encoder_adaptation: Original-query retrieval supervision only; no paired variant or consistency claim
automatic_query_views: Allowed inference transformations of original queries; not independently verified benchmark variants
prepared_profile: 50000 passages per language, complete available query groups
first_execution_profile: CPU pilot derived within existing full-profile splits; never a substitute for the full prepared-profile experiment

pilot.training_setting_rationale: Declared before any pilot retrieval metric: plain SGD without momentum saves Adam state memory; 0.001 is a mild clipped-update pilot rate, not an Adam-equivalent tuned rate. Zero weight decay avoids shrinkage dominating tiny adaptation diagnostics.
pilot.truncation_policy: Right truncation at 128 tokens, title plus body, one vector per original passage; identical for pretrained and adapted encoders

reporting_and_deployment_rule.deployment_selection: Predeclared seed 13 and its language-specific full gate; never choose a deployment seed from final scores
reporting_and_deployment_rule.seed_summary: Per-seed results plus descriptive mean and range; seeds are not independent query samples
reporting_and_deployment_rule.negative_results: Retain and report unchanged or worse results and unavailable branches

final_evaluation_policy: Do not score official development until models, indexes, selection decisions and experimental configurations are frozen.
unsupported_claims: Consistency/noise augmentation benefit without reviewed pairs
Cross-lingual relevance from pooled monolingual judgments
Contextual Bengali language-ID accuracy from Hindi-English auxiliary test
